11155111.name: Ethereum Sepolia
11155111.systemName: ZuCitySystem (this sandbox deploy predates the mainnet rename; ABI identical to JapanGlobalSystem)
11155111.referrerFeeBpsGetter: on Sepolia the getter is referrerFeeBPS() (capital) = 1000 = 10% (verified 2026-08-16); the casing differs from mainnet's referrerFeeBps()

dateEncoding.daysCount: inclusive calendar days of the stay (uint8, 1-255)
dateEncoding.availabilityBit: bit = startDay - 1; segment = floor((startDay - 1) / 182); bit set = day booked
dateEncoding.storageKey: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint64 listingId, uint8 year, uint256 segment))
dateEncoding.yearCross: stays crossing Dec 31 are supported; occupancy wraps into (year + 1, segment 0)

verifiedExample.observed: deterministic from the encoding — a booking of (year 3, startDay 121, daysCount 31) sets bitmap bits 120-150 in segment 0; confirm any specific booking with isAvailable

sentinelMeaning: items(id).minUnitPrice equal to 2^128-2 means the item is application-gated and cannot be bought directly; follow the item's externalPurchaseLink / apply flow instead

order: set totalPaid = quote on receipts[0] ONLY
purchaseRules.multiManager: encode one buy/bulkBuy per manager group and batch via multicall(bytes[])

fiat.auth: Privy JWT Bearer token (browser sessions on zucity.org are exempt)
fiat.response: single manager: {sessionId, url}; multiple managers: {sessions: [{managerAddress, sessionId, url}]}

rateLimitsPerIpPerMinute.onExceeded: HTTP 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit headers

rest.notes: filters AND-combined; param names case-insensitive; itemtype accepts names ticket|membership|art|merch|room|suite|villa|venue|equipment or numbers 0-10 (sponsorship=2 and service=5 are number-only); dates strict YYYY-MM-DD; cached ~60s

format = ics (default) | json | google | ical; google → 302 to https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?cid=webcal%3A%2F%2Fzucity.org%2Fapi%2Fcalendars (Google Calendar subscribe flow); ical → 302 to webcal://zucity.org/api/calendars; json response includes chain-derived inventory[] (onchain prices in token base units, manager, booked days) and reservations[]
slug = community name or 0x wallet address (user calendar)
scraped Luma events for affiliated calendars

trpc.authHeader: Authorization: Bearer <PRIVY_JWT>. Agents are first-class citizens: create your OWN account by completing the same Privy login zucity.org uses — email OR wallet — at https://zucity.org/en/about/zucity/agent, then send the resulting Privy access token as the Bearer JWT. A wallet-holding agent can drive Privy's wallet auth itself; there are no API keys and no separate ZuCity signup endpoint (the Privy login IS the signup, not a bypass). The token is a short-lived Privy session token — obtain a fresh one from Privy when it expires. The keyless MCP never holds your token or creates your account; that is your own credential

referral.twoDistinctPaths: Two separate referral rails — do not conflate them. Passing your wallet as referrer earns cash and NO points; sharing ?ref=<username> earns points and NO cash; they are not documented to stack on one booking.

pathA_onchainCash.needs: a wallet address (no account or username required)
pathA_onchainCash.gets: an instant cash fee split in the payment token (e.g. USDC)
pathA_onchainCash.how: pass your wallet as the referrer argument of buy/bulkBuy
pathA_onchainCash.settles: onchain, in the same purchase tx, recorded in receipts(id).referrerFee
pathA_onchainCash.rate: mainnet referrerFeeBps() = 1000 (10%); Sepolia referrerFeeBPS() = 1000 (10%); read the getter for the current value (manager-mutable); verified 2026-08-16

pathB_offchainPoints.needs: a username (member account; create via member.setMyUsername) — your username IS your referral code
pathB_offchainPoints.gets: 300 points per converted booking, toward an intended, unpriced future token airdrop (no guaranteed value, amount, or date)
pathB_offchainPoints.how: share https://zucity.org/?ref=<username>, pass referralCode in POST /api/stripe/checkout, or call referral.attributeBooking({referralCode, receiptIds})
pathB_offchainPoints.settles: off-chain attribution only — nothing settles onchain; self-referral is blocked and attribution is idempotent per receipt

liveVerifiedSamples.note: prices and quotes drift as managers relist — always re-read items()/getPriceAndDiscountRate before transacting. Mainnet snapshot re-verified 2026-08-16; the sample buyer has no special standing, so discountRateBps = 0. Read /api/inventory for the live item count.
liveVerifiedSamples.quoteBulk: items 18+20, same day -> (14000000, 0) = 14 USDC, 0% for a no-standing buyer
liveVerifiedSamples.availability: deterministic from the encoding: isAvailable(3, 3, 121, 1) = false when day 121 is booked; day 120 and day 152 = true

notSupported: GET /api/inventory/{id} does not exist (404) — fetch /api/inventory and select by id client-side
POST /api/inventory returns 405 — the inventory API is read-only
no free-text search parameter — use the documented filters

no API keys and no separate ZuCity signup endpoint — the Privy login IS account creation, not a missing rail; agents are first-class: create your own account via Privy email OR wallet auth at https://zucity.org/en/about/zucity/agent, then authenticate with your own Privy access token as the Bearer JWT
tRPC mutations are never called via GET
no itemsCounter() function — enumerate the registry via allItems(...) or /api/calendars?format=json
no public refund API — cancellations go through cancel(receiptId) and incur up to cancelFeeBps (30%)
items priced in JPY are fiat-path only (the JPY pay token address 0x...004A is a placeholder, not a deployed ERC20)
the REST inventory price/manager fields are display metadata and can drift from the chain — never build transactions from them

no official ZuCity bot exists on Discord, Telegram, or WhatsApp (verified absent 2026-07-22) — join the community Telegram group (urls.telegramCommunity) or Discord server (urls.discordCommunity), or run your own agent against the public surface (integrations.md § 4)
